## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` (0 errors, 0 warnings), `pnpm test` and `pnpm test:e2e` pass
- [ ] I looked at every page I changed at desktop width and at 390px
- [ ] New behaviour has a test
- [ ] If page text, a chapter list or a share picture changed: I ran `pnpm og` and committed the JPEGs
- [ ] No existing chapter or module id was renamed (saved progress is keyed by them)
- [ ] Facts, numbers and answers come from data files with sources, not typed into copy
- [ ] Credits kept (Colorfigures by April Zhu; module author)
- [ ] If this changes a decision in AGENTS.md, AGENTS.md is updated and the PR says why
